normalization.source: fixed initial measured TCP / measured goal anchors; XY alpha, Z beta=clip((7alpha-4)/3); ninth learned alpha

network: No point-cloud encoder; measured-goal/state MLPs; history + timer; Diffusion UNet [64,128,256]; measured RGB-D goal MLP 8-64-64

goal_gate_supervision.label: expert_frame>=20, training loss only
goal_gate_supervision.gate: predicted from reset-relative robot history, gripper and executed-command timer; hard straight-through mask

goal_memory.source: fixed RGB-D surface normals and depth-supported silhouettes; first valid measurement; known axis-aligned green6cm cube

observation_normalization.source: fixed simulation task bounds; IK/physics independently checked; not hardware safety limits

action_limits.source: fixed simulation task bounds; IK/physics independently checked; not hardware safety limits

previous_goal_memory.source: initial fixed-camera RGB-D; green channel geometry; known 6cm target size

perception_ablation.reason: occlusion/raster rows were mistaken for physical side faces; source indices and simulator object poses are not detector inputs

gate_memory_ablation.rule: latch predicted gate>0.5 OR an actually returned valid-goal anchor weight>1/14; clear only on explicit episode reset
gate_memory_ablation.threshold_source: 1/14 is half the smallest positive supervised transport anchor (1/7); no runtime expert phase or frame number
gate_memory_ablation.motivation: has-started is a historical event, not a classifier that may revert after gripper opening

inference_ablation.ensemble: mean of normalized latent trajectories before geometric decoding
inference_ablation.constraints_source: verified constant/binary action labels of every training episode

release_guard_ablation.inputs: measured robot pose, measured RGB-D goal, policy commands and their history; no object/contact ground truth
release_guard_ablation.rule: defer a learned release request until two stable intervals at the nominal placement command; hold pose for opening plus two more intervals; never force release without a model request

controller_filter.semantics: same desired Cartesian targets and static drive gains; exponential reference convergence each physics tick; original reset unchanged

transport_guard_ablation.inputs: actual robot state, RGB-D target and policy transport/release events only; no obstacle/cube ground-truth transforms
transport_guard_ablation.purpose: preserve the learned horizontal route while preventing transport below the destination approach height
